description: This file defines the 'GrantRevokeIndex' class, which manages indexes of granted and revoked permissions associated with subjects in a policy enforcement context. It provides methods for querying permission states, overriding permissions, and retrieving subjects with specific permission sets.

classes.name: GrantRevokeIndex
classes.description: A final class that indexes granted and revoked permissions for subjects, supporting permission checks, overrides, and retrieval of affected subjects.

methods.name: GrantRevokeIndex
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty index.

methods.name: GrantRevokeIndex
methods.description: Constructor initializing the index with provided grant and revoke maps.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns the map of permissions granted to subjects.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns the map of permissions revoked from subjects.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy of the index with each permission-subject pair weight decremented by one.

methods.name: overrideBy
methods.description: Mutates the current index by applying updates from another GrantRevokeIndex, modifying grants and revocations accordingly.

methods.name: hasPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the given subject IDs have all specified permissions granted without being revoked at a higher or equal weight.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjectIds
methods.description: Returns subjects for whom all specified permissions are granted and any that are revoked, marked as deprecated in favor of getEffectedSubjects.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjects
methods.description: Returns an EffectedSubjects object indicating which subjects have all permissions granted and which have permissions revoked.

methods.name: getGrantedSubjectIds
methods.description: Deprecated: retrieves subject IDs granted the specified permissions.

methods.name: getGrantedSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization subjects granted the specified permissions.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjectIds
methods.description: Deprecated: retrieves subject IDs for whom the permissions are revoked.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves authorization subjects for whom the specified permissions are revoked.
